sec10-card-sec10-R08.question_text: What two final cargo and exterior checks belong right before pulling out with a trailer?
sec10-card-sec10-R08.teaching_text: An unlatched camper bay swinging open at sixty spills tools across lanes in seconds.

sec10-card-sec10-F12.question_text: How does a load-distributing hitch work, and which trailers rely on it?
sec10-card-sec10-F12.teaching_text: Spring bars transfer heavy boat, utility, or camper tongue sag evenly across every truck and trailer axle.

sec10-card-sec10-F13.question_text: Which three critical steps secure a ball-coupler trailer connection?
sec10-card-sec10-F13.teaching_text: Crossing safety chains forms a steel cradle underneath that catches the tongue if the coupler pops loose.
sec10-card-sec10-F13.must_match_memory_hook: Ball seated, latch locked, chains crossed

visual_sync.text_span: Ball seated, latch locked, chains crossed

sec10-card-sec10-F14.question_text: How must the hitch ball mount and trailer electrical cord be secured?
sec10-card-sec10-F14.teaching_text: Dragging wires chafe bare on asphalt, knocking out trailer brake lights and electric brakes mid-trip.

sec10-card-sec10-R04.question_text: What metal integrity inspection belongs on the coupler hardware and trailer tongue before towing?
sec10-card-sec10-R04.teaching_text: Hairline tongue cracks or bent couplers snap completely under highway pothole jolts.
sec10-card-sec10-R04.must_match_memory_hook: All parts intact; straight uncracked tongue

visual_sync.text_span: All parts intact; straight uncracked tongue

sec10-card-sec10-R03.question_text: How does a bumper ball-and-coupler setup differ from a fifth-wheel hitch in placement and stability?
sec10-card-sec10-R03.teaching_text: Centering trailer weight over the pickup rear axle via a bed kingpin slashes sway compared with rear-bumper leverage.

sec10-card-sec10-F15.question_text: Where does a fifth-wheel hitch mount, and what bed-space precaution does it require?
sec10-card-sec10-F15.teaching_text: Though rock-solid on highways, fifth-wheel plates fill most of the bed and crush toolboxes left behind during turns.

sec10-card-sec10-F16.question_text: What must you lock before backing under a fifth-wheel kingpin, and what must you verify once jaws shut?
sec10-card-sec10-F16.teaching_text: Unlocked jaws can hold long enough to clear the driveway before dropping the trailer nose onto the tailgate.

sec10-card-sec10-R06.question_text: What hardware condition must the fifth-wheel mounting frame and trailer kingpin show?
sec10-card-sec10-R06.teaching_text: Missing bed-rail bolts or a bent steel kingpin prevent locking jaws from clamping squarely.

sec10-card-sec10-F17.question_text: What three visual signs confirm a fifth wheel is seated and lubricated properly?
sec10-card-sec10-F17.teaching_text: Any visible gap between upper plate and greased skid plate means the kingpin rode high over the jaws.

sec10-card-sec10-R07.question_text: What must you inspect on fifth-wheel cords, the support platform, and the release arm?
sec10-card-sec10-R07.teaching_text: Confirming the release handle's safety latch prevents road vibration from popping the jaws open.

sec10-card-sec10-F18.question_text: How do you physically test your hitch before rolling out, and what cord slack is needed?
sec10-card-sec10-F18.teaching_text: Tugging gently against locked trailer brakes proves positive lockup while slack keeps sharp turns from ripping plugs.

sec10-card-sec10-F19.question_text: At which mileage and time milestones should you re-check your trailer and tie-downs on a trip?
sec10-card-sec10-F19.teaching_text: Straps settle during the opening fifty miles, and rechecking every three hours or hundred-fifty miles catches loosening.

sec10-card-sec10-F20.question_text: Is signaling turns and lane changes while towing merely polite advice or Nevada law?
sec10-card-sec10-F20.teaching_text: Wide, slow-accelerating trailers give surrounding traffic zero margin for unannounced lane shifts.

sec10-card-sec10-R10.question_text: What human lapse causes major towing crashes, and how do you counter it?
sec10-card-sec10-R10.teaching_text: Never assume nearby cars notice your long trailer—active mirror scans and early signals break tunnel vision.

sec10-card-sec10-F21.question_text: Surprisingly, why do empty trucks take longer to stop than loaded ones?
sec10-card-sec10-F21.teaching_text: Without cargo weight pressing stiff tires down, hard braking bounces empty rear axles across asphalt.

sec10-card-sec10-R09.question_text: How does cargo weight affect brake heat versus overall truck-suspension design?
sec10-card-sec10-R09.teaching_text: Heavy springs, tires, and brakes deliver balanced road grip under their intended load despite higher heat.

sec10-card-sec10-R11.question_text: Why does managing front, rear, and side space matter even more when towing than in a solo car?
sec10-card-sec10-R11.teaching_text: Added length and weight erase last-second swerve options, making proactive space cushions your main defense.

sec10-card-sec10-F22.question_text: How does steering wheel direction differ at the start of backing a trailer versus a solo car?
sec10-card-sec10-F22.teaching_text: Turning the wheel top away kicks the hitch nose opposite so the trailer tail pivots where you want.

sec10-card-sec10-R12.question_text: What two-part steering motion backs a trailer smoothly around a turn?
sec10-card-sec10-R12.teaching_text: Holding opposite lock too long jackknifes the hitch, so chase the trailer smoothly once it angles.

sec10-card-sec10-F23.question_text: What smart parking habit lets you skip risky trailer backing altogether?
sec10-card-sec10-F23.teaching_text: Picking pull-through spaces lets you roll straight out forward with full visibility instead of blind reversing.

sec10-card-sec10-F24.question_text: What inspection and speed rule apply every single time before backing a trailer?
sec10-card-sec10-F24.teaching_text: Stepping outside spots low posts and side pinch points, while idling slowly catches drift before jackknifing.

sec10-card-sec10-R16.question_text: Which high obstacles are easiest to miss in side mirrors unless you step out before backing?
sec10-card-sec10-R16.teaching_text: Side mirrors aim down toward tires and curbs, leaving tall camper roofs blind to drooping tree limbs.

sec10-card-sec10-F25.question_text: Which way do you turn the top of the steering wheel if your trailer drifts off line while backing?
sec10-card-sec10-F25.teaching_text: Steering the wheel top toward the drifting side swings the tow hitch back underneath the wandering trailer.

sec10-card-sec10-F26.question_text: Toward which side of the rig should you always try to back and turn—even if circling the block?
sec10-card-sec10-F26.teaching_text: Looking straight out your left window beats blind-side right backing where the trailer body blocks your mirror.

sec10-card-sec10-F27.question_text: Where should a backing helper stand, and what must you agree on before shifting into reverse?
sec10-card-sec10-F27.teaching_text: If your spotter vanishes from your mirror, stop immediately using your pre-arranged stop hand signal.

sec10-card-sec10-R13.question_text: What three habits keep straight-line trailer backing stress-free?
sec10-card-sec10-R13.teaching_text: Starting straight, catching mirror drift tiny, and pulling forward to reset beats forcing a crooked angle.

sec10-card-sec10-F28.question_text: How should you swing wide for a tight right trailer turn without inviting cars to sneak inside?
sec10-card-sec10-F28.teaching_text: Jug-handling left early opens a deadly gap on your right that impatient drivers dive straight into.

sec10-card-sec10-F29.question_text: What should you do—and never do—if finishing a tight turn requires crossing into an oncoming lane?
sec10-card-sec10-F29.teaching_text: Letting cross-street cars clear first avoids nose-to-nose standoffs where blind backing hits traffic behind you.

sec10-card-sec10-F30.question_text: How far into an intersection must you pull before turning left with a trailer, and why?
sec10-card-sec10-F30.teaching_text: Cutting left early drags off-tracking trailer wheels straight across the hood of cars waiting on your left.

sec10-card-sec10-F31.question_text: Which lane must a towing rig always pick when two side-by-side left-turn lanes are offered?
sec10-card-sec10-F31.teaching_text: Starting in the outer turn lane lets you swing wide safely without sideswiping blind-side cars on your right.

sec10-card-sec10-R14.question_text: What goes wrong turning left too early versus starting from the inside dual left lane?
sec10-card-sec10-R14.teaching_text: Both mistakes stem from trailer off-tracking, either cutting inside left cars or swinging wide right unseen.
sec10-card-sec10-R14.must_match_memory_hook: Early clips left; inner swings right

visual_sync.text_span: Early clips left; inner swings right

sec10-card-sec10-F32.question_text: Why must a towing rig wait for a much wider traffic gap to cross or merge?
sec10-card-sec10-F32.teaching_text: Dragging extra trailer length across lanes sluggishly takes seconds longer before your rear bumper clears oncoming speed.

sec10-card-sec10-F33.question_text: Which three real-world factors make posted bridge clearance signs untrustworthy?
sec10-card-sec10-F33.teaching_text: Repaving layers, packed winter snow, or high-sprung empty trailers shave inches off posted bridge signs.

sec10-card-sec10-F34.question_text: What should you do whenever you doubt your rig can clear an overhead bridge or structure?
sec10-card-sec10-F34.teaching_text: Unmarked country underpasses peel camper roofs open instantly, so rerouting beats guessing every single time.

sec10-card-sec10-R15.question_text: How should you position a tall trailer when sloped pavement tilts the roof toward roadside trees or signs?
sec10-card-sec10-R15.teaching_text: Road crown leans high trailer corners surprisingly far right into utility poles and low curb branches.

sec10-card-sec10-F35.question_text: Why must heavily loaded rigs crawl carefully across raised train tracks and drainage dips?
sec10-card-sec10-F35.teaching_text: Sagging springs drop trailer frames low enough to high-center and stick dead across active train rails.

sec10-card-sec10-F36.question_text: When towing a multi-trailer combination, where must the heaviest trailer always sit?
sec10-card-sec10-F36.teaching_text: Putting heavy mass behind a light front trailer whips the whole train violently out of control.

sec10-card-sec10-R18.question_text: How do combination rigs compare with single vehicles in size, skill, and rollover history?
sec10-card-sec10-R18.teaching_text: Drivers inside a steady cab often never feel the back trailer tipping until rollover is unstoppable.

sec10-card-sec10-F37.question_text: What triggers the crack-the-whip effect on trailers, and how must you steer to prevent it?
sec10-card-sec10-F37.teaching_text: A sudden lane jerk multiplies rearward down each hitch until the trailing box snaps over sideways.

sec10-card-sec10-R17.question_text: What does a rearward amplification score of two point zero mean, and how high do triples reach?
sec10-card-sec10-R17.teaching_text: Doubling at two point zero and climbing to three point five on triples proves abrupt swerves are lethal.

sec10-card-sec10-R19.question_text: Why do empty combination rigs stop worse than loaded ones, and how should you compensate?
sec10-card-sec10-R19.teaching_text: Powerful brakes lock bouncing unloaded tires easily, demanding huge following space and early feathering.
sec10-card-sec10-R19.must_match_memory_hook: Stiff springs skip; scan, gap wide

visual_sync.text_span: Stiff springs skip; scan, gap wide

sec10-card-sec10-R20.question_text: When is a trailer jackknife likeliest, and how do you catch it before recovery becomes impossible?
sec10-card-sec10-R20.teaching_text: Catching the first inch of sideways swing in side mirrors during hard braking lets you release before folding.
sec10-card-sec10-R20.must_match_memory_hook: Empty or light; check mirrors braking

visual_sync.text_span: Empty or light; check mirrors braking

sec10-card-sec10-F38.question_text: How do you recover when locked trailer wheels start skidding—and why skip the trailer hand brake?
sec10-card-sec10-F38.teaching_text: Only rolling tires grip sideways again, whereas pulling the hand valve locks skidding wheels even harder.

sec11-card-sec11-F01.question_text: What type of insurance must every registered motor vehicle in Nevada carry?
sec11-card-sec11-F01.teaching_text: Financial responsibility laws protect other people from medical and repair bills when a crash is your fault.

sec11-card-sec11-R01.question_text: When do Nevada's minimum liability coverage amounts legally apply to you?
sec11-card-sec11-R01.teaching_text: Even a parked car still carrying active Nevada plates must maintain continuous minimum liability protection.

sec11-card-sec11-F02.question_text: Which two formats satisfy Nevada's rule for carrying proof of vehicle insurance?
sec11-card-sec11-F02.teaching_text: Keeping either the physical insurer card in the glovebox or digital proof ready avoids traffic-stop citations.

sec11-card-sec11-F03.question_text: What are Nevada's minimum liability dollar limits for injury or death to one person versus two or more?
sec11-card-sec11-F03.teaching_text: Memorize twenty-five thousand single-victim and fifty thousand multi-victim bodily coverage for the knowledge exam.

sec11-card-sec11-F04.question_text: What minimum dollar amount of property-damage liability must a Nevada policy include per crash?
sec11-card-sec11-F04.teaching_text: Combined with injury minimums, twenty thousand completes Nevada's twenty-five, fifty, twenty insurance split.

sec11-card-sec11-F05.question_text: What does Nevada's electronic liability insurance verification system do behind the scenes?
sec11-card-sec11-F05.teaching_text: Insurers report policy drops electronically to the state, catching uninsured plates without waiting for a traffic stop.

sec11-card-sec11-F06.question_text: What fee and fine range hit when a registration is suspended for an unreplaced insurance lapse?
sec11-card-sec11-F06.teaching_text: Skipping active coverage escalates from two hundred fifty up to seventeen hundred fifty dollars per vehicle.

sec11-card-sec11-R03.question_text: If a lapsed insurance policy covered three family cars, how are Nevada's lapse fines charged?
sec11-card-sec11-R03.teaching_text: Letting one family policy drop multiplies reinstatement fees and fines across every single plated car listed.

sec11-card-sec11-F07.question_text: Beyond registration fines, what two license or insurance penalties can follow a coverage lapse?
sec11-card-sec11-F07.teaching_text: Longer or repeat lapses add state-monitored insurance filings and can suspend your driver license for thirty days.

sec11-card-sec11-F08.question_text: How does crash and insurance info reach the state licensing agency when police investigate at the scene?
sec11-card-sec11-F08.teaching_text: When an officer writes an official scene report, their filing sends insurance, damage, and injury details forward.

sec11-card-sec11-F09.question_text: When police do not investigate at the scene, what damage or injury threshold triggers a ten-day state crash report?
sec11-card-sec11-F09.teaching_text: Missing that ten-day filing deadline after an uninvestigated crash risks losing your license and registration.
sec11-card-sec11-F09.must_match_memory_hook: Seven-fifty damage or injury, ten days

visual_sync.text_span: Seven-fifty damage or injury, ten days

sec11-card-sec11-R02.question_text: How does crash reporting differ when an officer investigates versus when no officer responds?
sec11-card-sec11-R02.teaching_text: Never assume swapping insurance cards privately ends your duty if damage hits seven hundred fifty dollars without police.

sec11-card-sec11-F10.question_text: Who must complete the state Report of Crash form, and where can you obtain a copy?
sec11-card-sec11-F10.teaching_text: Both involved drivers and registered vehicle owners share responsibility, with forms easy to grab online or at police counters.
sec11-card-sec11-F10.must_match_memory_hook: Drivers or owners; state, police, online

visual_sync.text_span: Drivers or owners; state, police, online

sec11-card-sec11-F11.question_text: Which three questions does the state Financial Responsibility Section decide after a reported crash?
sec11-card-sec11-F11.teaching_text: Reviewers verify who caused the wreck, whether active policies covered everyone, and total dollar damages owed.

sec11-card-sec11-F12.question_text: What three consequences face an uninsured driver found at fault in a Nevada crash?
sec11-card-sec11-F12.teaching_text: Driving bare leaves you personally funding crash damages through a state security deposit or payment agreement to keep privileges.

sec11-card-sec11-F13.question_text: What happens if you ignore your legal duty to report a qualifying crash to the state?
sec11-card-sec11-F13.teaching_text: Hiding an unreported wreck backfires by suspending your license, your plates, or both at once.

sec11-card-sec11-F14.question_text: What is Nevada's state-monitored reinstatement proof-of-insurance certificate, and how does it work?
sec11-card-sec11-F14.teaching_text: Your insurer notifies the state immediately if coverage drops while restoring a suspended or revoked privilege.

sec11-card-sec11-F15.question_text: When does monitored reinstatement coverage actually begin, how often do you file it, and when should you buy it?
sec11-card-sec11-F15.teaching_text: Buying that certificate months before finishing your suspension wastes money before your reinstatement date starts.

sec11-card-sec11-R04.question_text: How does Nevada's crash-reporting form differ from its monitored proof-of-insurance filing?
sec11-card-sec11-R04.teaching_text: Test questions pair both numbered forms specifically to catch people mixing up post-crash reports with reinstatement policies.

sec11-card-sec11-R05.question_text: Who determines how much monitored reinstatement insurance coverage costs?
sec11-card-sec11-R05.teaching_text: Because private insurers set their own risk rates rather than a flat state fee, shopping carriers matters.

sec11-card-sec11-F16.question_text: Which four actions come first whenever you are involved in a crash?
sec11-card-sec11-F16.teaching_text: Stopping immediately, summoning medics, protecting the scene from secondary hits, and calling officers fulfills Nevada law.
sec11-card-sec11-F16.must_match_memory_hook: Stop, aid injured, warn, call police

visual_sync.text_span: Stop, aid injured, warn, call police

sec11-card-sec11-F17.question_text: What should you do with drivable cars after a property-damage-only fender bender with zero injuries?
sec11-card-sec11-F17.teaching_text: Leaving drivable cars parked mid-freeway over a scratched bumper causes deadly secondary highway pileups.

sec11-card-sec11-R06.question_text: How do your opening steps differ between an injury crash and a minor drivable fender bender?
sec11-card-sec11-R06.teaching_text: Medical help and scene warnings come first with injuries, whereas minor damage-only bumps clear active lanes first.
sec11-card-sec11-R06.must_match_memory_hook: Injuries get aid; property clears lanes

visual_sync.text_span: Injuries get aid; property clears lanes

sec11-card-sec11-F18.question_text: Which five pieces of identification and vehicle data must drivers exchange after a crash?
sec11-card-sec11-F18.teaching_text: Missing plate registration or policy details at the curb stalls claims and state crash filings later.

sec11-card-sec11-F19.question_text: What must you do if you bump an unattended parked vehicle or roadside property?
sec11-card-sec11-F19.teaching_text: Driving off without finding the owner or leaving a written note carrying all five details turns a bump into hit-and-run.
sec11-card-sec11-F19.must_match_memory_hook: Give owner or leave five details

visual_sync.text_span: Give owner or leave five details

sec11-card-sec11-F20.question_text: How does Nevada classify a driver license, and what happens if you stop driving safely?
sec11-card-sec11-F20.teaching_text: Because driving is a conditional privilege rather than an absolute right, unsafe lawbreakers face suspension, revocation, or cancellation.

sec11-card-sec11-F21.question_text: What events post to your Nevada driving record—and do tickets from other states follow you home?
sec11-card-sec11-F21.teaching_text: Interstate compacts share traffic convictions nationwide, so an out-of-state speeding ticket still hits your Nevada file.

sec11-card-sec11-F22.question_text: How many years do ordinary tickets stay reportable to insurers versus impaired-driving convictions on your record?
sec11-card-sec11-F22.teaching_text: Routine moving tickets clear insurer reports after three years, whereas impaired-driving convictions stick for seven.

sec11-card-sec11-R07.question_text: How do the three-year and seven-year retention timelines compare on a Nevada driving history?
sec11-card-sec11-R07.teaching_text: Seven-year tracking lets courts escalate repeat impaired-driving penalties across that entire seven-year window.

sec11-card-sec11-F23.question_text: When do demerit points land on your Nevada record, and across what rolling time window are they tallied?
sec11-card-sec11-F23.teaching_text: Points post once court conviction notices arrive and accumulate across any rolling twelve-month span.

sec11-card-sec11-F24.question_text: How many demerit points collected inside twelve months trigger automatic license suspension?
sec11-card-sec11-F24.teaching_text: Stacking two or three reckless or right-of-way tickets inside one year hits twelve points fast.

sec11-card-sec11-F25.question_text: When can an approved traffic safety course shave demerit points, how many come off, and how often?
sec11-card-sec11-F25.teaching_text: Once you hit twelve points it is too late, and even after dropping three points the conviction stays visible.

sec11-card-sec11-R09.question_text: When do traffic-school point reductions actually take effect, and does the state warn risky drivers?
sec11-card-sec11-R09.teaching_text: Signing up alone pauses nothing—the approved school must transmit completion credit while warning letters flag rising totals.

sec11-card-sec11-F26.question_text: Why do major convictions like impaired driving or causing substantial bodily harm carry zero demerit points?
sec11-card-sec11-F26.teaching_text: Instead of chipping away with points, severe offenses bypass the point chart and revoke your license directly.

sec11-card-sec11-R08.question_text: How does a twelve-point demerit suspension differ from a major-offense revocation?
sec11-card-sec11-R08.teaching_text: Accumulated minor tickets trigger suspension at twelve, whereas one single impaired-driving conviction revokes immediately.

sec11-card-sec11-F27.question_text: How many demerit points hit for reckless driving versus careless driving or failing to render crash aid?
sec11-card-sec11-F27.teaching_text: One eight-point reckless ticket puts you two-thirds of the way to suspension on a single stop.
sec11-card-sec11-F27.must_match_memory_hook: Reckless eight; careless or hit-and-run six

visual_sync.text_span: Reckless eight; careless or hit-and-run six

sec11-card-sec11-R10.question_text: How do the Nevada demerit-point values of reckless driving and careless driving compare?
sec11-card-sec11-R10.teaching_text: Keep eight versus six crisp because exam questions love swapping reckless and careless point numbers.

sec11-card-sec11-F28.question_text: Which four everyday tailgating, right-of-way, pedestrian, and red-light violations cost four points each?
sec11-card-sec11-F28.teaching_text: Three four-point mistakes—like tailgating, rolling a stop, and cutting off a walker—hit twelve and suspend you.

sec11-card-sec11-F29.question_text: Which three slow-driving, headlight, and weather-speed violations carry two demerit points each?
sec11-card-sec11-F29.teaching_text: Blocking traffic flow, blinding oncoming cars, or driving too fast for rain each tack two points on.

sec11-card-sec11-R11.question_text: Which speeding bracket matches the two-point penalty for driving too fast for conditions?
sec11-card-sec11-R11.teaching_text: Overdriving rain at the posted sign carries the exact same two-point sting as going twenty over.

sec11-card-sec11-F30.question_text: How do Nevada speeding points climb by ten-mile-per-hour brackets from one over up past forty-one over?
sec11-card-sec11-F30.teaching_text: One-to-ten costs one, eleven-to-twenty two, twenty-one-to-thirty three, thirty-one-to-forty four, and forty-one-plus five points.

sec11-card-sec11-R12.question_text: Is the handbook's point chart exhaustive, and how do commercial license holders fare?
sec11-card-sec11-R12.teaching_text: Professional drivers face stricter federal and state standards with extra points and career-threatening disqualifications.

sec11-card-sec11-R13.question_text: What can you check for free by setting up an online account on the state licensing website?
sec11-card-sec11-R13.teaching_text: Monitoring your own online portal catches surprise point totals, court notices, or expiration dates early.

sec11-card-sec11-F31.question_text: Which four dishonest acts involving a Nevada driver license or application are illegal?
sec11-card-sec11-F31.teaching_text: Faking application facts, tampering with plastic cards, or letting a friend borrow your license brings criminal penalties.

sec01-card-sec01-F01.question_text: Who must hold a Nevada driver license to drive on state roads, and which two groups are exempt?
sec01-card-sec01-F01.teaching_text: Exam questions test whether commuting border-state workers or stationed troops get mixed up with permanent residents.

sec01-card-sec01-F02.question_text: How many days after becoming a Nevada resident do you have to apply for a state driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-F02.teaching_text: Letting your old state plastic ride past the deadline turns an ordinary traffic stop into an unlicensed-resident citation.

sec01-card-sec01-F03.question_text: What minimum age, office visit, and four personal proofs are required to apply for a standard Nevada license?
sec01-card-sec01-F03.teaching_text: Showing up at a full-service counter missing even one identity or address record sends you home empty-handed.

sec01-card-sec01-F04.question_text: Is a Social Security Number required when applying for a Nevada Driver Authorization Card?
sec01-card-sec01-F04.teaching_text: Nevada created this driving credential specifically so applicants without federal tax numbers can still test, insure, and drive legally.

sec01-card-sec01-F05.question_text: How long does a first-time Nevada license last for an applicant under sixty-five, and what shortens that term?
sec01-card-sec01-F05.teaching_text: Test items contrast the normal birthday cycle against limited-term credentials tied to verified federal departure records.

sec01-card-sec01-F06.question_text: When does a Nevada license expire if limited-term immigration papers proved your name and birth date?
sec01-card-sec01-F06.teaching_text: Electronic federal checks anchor card validity directly to authorized stay dates rather than the standard birthday cycle.

sec01-card-sec01-F07.question_text: What is the maximum number of years any Nevada driver license or ID card may remain valid?
sec01-card-sec01-F07.teaching_text: Periodic renewal caps ensure photos, addresses, and vision screenings stay current across every motorist cohort.

sec01-card-sec01-F08.question_text: How does card validity differ between a driver license and an ID card for Nevadans aged sixty-five and older?
sec01-card-sec01-F08.teaching_text: More frequent license renewals check driving vision with age, whereas non-driving identification needs no road recheck.

sec01-card-sec01-F09.question_text: Who must co-sign a license application for someone under eighteen, and what legal responsibility do they take on?
sec01-card-sec01-F09.teaching_text: Signing for a teen puts the adult's own wallet on the hook if careless or willful driving wrecks property.

sec01-card-sec01-R01.question_text: Compare standard validity periods for an under-sixty-five license, a sixty-five-plus license, and a Nevada ID card?
sec01-card-sec01-R01.teaching_text: DMV multiple-choice distractors swap senior license and senior ID lengths to catch rushed readers.

sec01-card-sec01-R02.question_text: How does the Social Security proof rule contrast between a standard license and a Driver Authorization Card?
sec01-card-sec01-R02.teaching_text: Knowing which credential demands federal number proof prevents applicants from choosing the wrong application track.

sec01-card-sec01-F10.question_text: How many driver licenses or ID cards may a Nevada resident hold, and what happens to your old out-of-state card?
sec01-card-sec01-F10.teaching_text: Hole-punching and returning prior credentials prevents duplicate identities across state motor-vehicle registries.

sec01-card-sec01-F11.question_text: Which exam must every new Nevada resident take, and when can the remaining tests be waived?
sec01-card-sec01-F11.teaching_text: Even spotless out-of-state drivers still look into the eye machine at the counter before transferring.

sec01-card-sec01-F12.question_text: What ticket limit and license-status history must a new resident show to qualify for a test waiver?
sec01-card-sec01-F12.teaching_text: Drivers carrying stacked moving citations or active suspensions lose transfer shortcuts and face full testing.

sec01-card-sec01-F13.question_text: How far back must a transferring resident's record stay free of DUI convictions to waive extra testing?
sec01-card-sec01-F13.teaching_text: Recent impaired-driving history triggers full Nevada testing scrutiny instead of an automatic counter swap.

sec01-card-sec01-F14.question_text: What restriction rule, license-class match, and minimum age finish the new-resident test-waiver checklist?
sec01-card-sec01-F14.teaching_text: Younger transfers under adulthood or drivers switching vehicle classes still sit for Nevada exams.

sec01-card-sec01-F15.question_text: Must an active-duty US service member stationed in Nevada obtain a Nevada license if holding a valid home-state card?
sec01-card-sec01-F15.teaching_text: Federal and state reciprocity spares relocating troops from swapping plastic at every new duty station.

sec01-card-sec01-F16.question_text: Under what three conditions may tourists, out-of-state students, and seasonal residents drive here without a Nevada license?
sec01-card-sec01-F16.teaching_text: Out-of-state teen permits under Nevada's minimum driving age cannot legally operate on local streets.

sec01-card-sec01-F17.question_text: Which two national databases screen every applicant, and what happens if another state blocked your driving privilege?
sec01-card-sec01-F17.teaching_text: Moving across state lines never wipes out an unpaid suspension elsewhere, though non-driving ID remains available.

sec01-card-sec01-R03.question_text: Between vision, knowledge, and road exams, which is never waived for new residents and which can be?
sec01-card-sec01-R03.teaching_text: Test writers pair these three exams to verify you know eye screening applies universally on transfers.

sec01-card-sec01-R04.question_text: How does the rule for active-duty military drivers compare with the rule for visiting students or tourists?
sec01-card-sec01-R04.teaching_text: Civilian visitors face explicit minimum-age and local compliance conditions alongside holding valid home credentials.

sec01-card-sec01-F18.question_text: What document standard proves full legal name and birth date, and what are common examples?
sec01-card-sec01-F18.teaching_text: Photocopies or expired passports get turned away immediately at the document verification window.

sec01-card-sec01-F19.question_text: Where does a Nevada Department of Corrections ID card work as identity proof, and where does it fall short?
sec01-card-sec01-F19.teaching_text: State release credentials help returning residents get standard privileges without meeting federal boarding-pass standards.

sec01-card-sec01-F20.question_text: Does another state's Real ID marked limited term count as proof of name and birth date in Nevada?
sec01-card-sec01-F20.teaching_text: Temporary status cards from elsewhere require fresh federal immigration paperwork rather than state-to-state carryover.

sec01-card-sec01-F21.question_text: Which common certificates and non-Nevada cards are rejected as proof of legal name and age?
sec01-card-sec01-F21.teaching_text: Souvenir hospital footprint papers lack civil vital-records registration and stall plenty of teen permit trips.

sec01-card-sec01-F22.question_text: What must you bring if your current legal name no longer matches your primary birth or identity record?
sec01-card-sec01-F22.teaching_text: Every link from birth surname to current name needs an official court, marriage, or adoption paper.

sec01-card-sec01-R05.question_text: Contrast a Nevada Corrections ID card against an out-of-state limited-term Real ID as identity proof?
sec01-card-sec01-R05.teaching_text: Knowing which card works for standard issuance versus neither saves wasted trips to the counter.

sec01-card-sec01-R06.question_text: Which older Resident Alien Card version does the Nevada DMV accept, and which versions are refused?
sec01-card-sec01-R06.teaching_text: Expired dated editions lack valid status verification, whereas legacy no-expiration printings remain federally recognized.

sec01-card-sec01-R07.question_text: Will the Nevada DMV force holders of an undated Resident Alien Card to replace it on their own?
sec01-card-sec01-R07.teaching_text: State clerks follow federal homeland-security policy shifts rather than inventing local replacement mandates.

sec01-card-sec01-R08.question_text: What companion document must accompany an expired I-ninety-four form at the DMV?
sec01-card-sec01-R08.teaching_text: An expired arrival record alone proves nothing current without an official federal action notice extending stay.

sec01-card-sec01-R09.question_text: What label goes onto a Nevada card issued from temporary work papers, and how are immigration papers checked?
sec01-card-sec01-R09.teaching_text: Every temporary federal document triggers live electronic status verification and prints a matching card notice.

sec01-card-sec01-F23.question_text: Which original records prove your Social Security Number, and what kind of paystub is rejected?
sec01-card-sec01-F23.teaching_text: Masked tax forms showing only four digits or penciled wage slips fail fraud-prevention checks.

sec01-card-sec01-F24.question_text: What special sign-off do alternative identity or SSN documents need, and what card can they never support?
sec01-card-sec01-F24.teaching_text: Federal security rules forbid local supervisor exceptions from producing a gold-star credential.

sec01-card-sec01-R15.question_text: What formatting and certification rules apply when submitting a translated document at the DMV?
sec01-card-sec01-R15.teaching_text: Partial summaries or unsigned friend notes get rejected because clerks need complete certified English text.

sec01-card-sec01-F25.question_text: What visual marking sets a Nevada Real ID apart from a standard Nevada license or ID?
sec01-card-sec01-F25.teaching_text: Airport screeners check the upper corner star cutout instantly rather than reading fine license details.

sec01-card-sec01-F26.question_text: Between which two card tiers may eligible Nevada applicants choose, and what five items must the DMV verify?
sec01-card-sec01-F26.teaching_text: Real ID remains optional in Nevada, provided the state verifies core identity, status, and street residence.

sec01-card-sec01-F27.question_text: How many residency documents must a Real ID applicant bring, and what examples qualify?
sec01-card-sec01-F27.teaching_text: Post-office boxes cannot prove physical living quarters when utility, lease, or bank statements are required.

sec01-card-sec01-R10.question_text: How do a Real ID card and a standard card differ in printed markings and federal compliance?
sec01-card-sec01-R10.teaching_text: Choosing a standard card works fine for driving while skipping federal security-checkpoint acceptance.

sec01-card-sec01-R11.question_text: How are alternative identity documents treated for a standard card compared with a Real ID card?
sec01-card-sec01-R11.teaching_text: Strict federal document lists leave zero discretion for substitute records on gold-star credentials.

sec01-card-sec01-R12.question_text: What security goals drove Congress to pass the Real ID Act?
sec01-card-sec01-R12.teaching_text: Uniform state verification rules make counterfeiting or fraudulently obtaining official travel credentials much harder.

sec01-card-sec01-R13.question_text: What paperwork must a current standard Nevada license holder bring to upgrade to Real ID, and how is it handled?
sec01-card-sec01-R13.teaching_text: Prior standard issuance does not waive bringing physical birth, tax, and address originals back for imaging.

sec01-card-sec01-F28.question_text: How long does a Driver Authorization Card last, when must you carry it, and how are updates handled?
sec01-card-sec01-F28.teaching_text: Unlike eight-year standard licenses with online portals, DAC holders visit an office for renewals and moves.

sec01-card-sec01-F29.question_text: Which single identity records allow an applicant to qualify on the one-document list for a DAC?
sec01-card-sec01-F29.teaching_text: Military discharge papers and tribal blood certificates provide standalone proof on the DAC track.

sec01-card-sec01-F30.question_text: If not using a single primary record, how many documents from the secondary foreign or out-of-state list establish DAC identity?
sec01-card-sec01-F30.teaching_text: Pairing records like a foreign passport and consular card verifies identity without US vital-record originals.

sec01-card-sec01-F31.question_text: For what official purposes can a Driver Authorization Card not be used, and how is application data protected?
sec01-card-sec01-F31.teaching_text: Keeping driving authorization separate from benefit eligibility encourages every road user to test and carry insurance.

sec01-card-sec01-R14.question_text: How does a Driver Authorization Card function behind the wheel versus at an ID check?
sec01-card-sec01-R14.teaching_text: Behind the wheel all traffic laws match a standard license, while non-driving agencies reject it as identification.

sec01-card-sec01-F32.question_text: Which original Nevada card, permit, or license applicants must prove a physical Nevada residential address?
sec01-card-sec01-F32.teaching_text: Whether choosing Real ID, standard, or first-time DAC, Nevada ties original credentials to a real street residence.

sec01-card-sec01-F33.question_text: How many residency documents are needed, and what dating rules govern the two document groups?
sec01-card-sec01-F33.teaching_text: Bringing year-old utility bills fails the freshness check required for monthly-statement categories.

sec01-card-sec01-F34.question_text: When can a hotel, motel, RV park, or campground receipt count toward proving Nevada residency?
sec01-card-sec01-F34.teaching_text: Weekend tourist receipts prove nothing permanent, whereas a month-long continuous stay establishes local residence.

sec01-card-sec01-F35.question_text: What two options let a parent or guardian prove Nevada residency for an applicant under eighteen?
sec01-card-sec01-F35.teaching_text: High schoolers rarely have utility bills in their own name, so parent co-habitation paperwork bridges the gap.

sec01-card-sec01-R16.question_text: Which three department-approved DMV forms can establish Nevada residency in special living situations?
sec01-card-sec01-R16.teaching_text: Official affidavits give unhoused residents, room renters, and family members structured ways to verify address.

sec01-card-sec01-R17.question_text: Which homeowner statement and election record appear on Nevada's acceptable residency document list?
sec01-card-sec01-R17.teaching_text: Notarization deters casual favors by requiring the property owner to swear formally that you live there.

sec01-card-sec01-F36.question_text: What gets added to your Nevada license if you need glasses or contacts to pass the DMV eye screening?
sec01-card-sec01-F36.teaching_text: Passing with lenses obligates you to wear them every trip so highway sight matches counter testing.

sec01-card-sec01-F37.question_text: What three subject areas does the Nevada knowledge test cover, and what testing formats or languages exist?
sec01-card-sec01-F37.teaching_text: Knowing oral accommodations and Spanish Class C options exist lowers test-day anxiety for eligible learners.

sec01-card-sec01-F38.question_text: How much does Nevada charge for initial knowledge and skills testing versus each retest before issuance?
sec01-card-sec01-F38.teaching_text: Studying thoroughly before day one saves repeat ten-dollar trips back to the testing terminal.

sec01-card-sec01-F39.question_text: Which paperwork and ten equipment items does the DMV examiner inspect before your road test starts?
sec01-card-sec01-F39.teaching_text: A burned-out brake bulb or missing insurance card cancels your drive appointment right in the lot.

sec01-card-sec01-F40.question_text: What mechanical and cabin standards must a road-test car meet, and who may ride along?
sec01-card-sec01-F40.teaching_text: Bringing friends, parents, or pets in the back seat disqualifies the cabin until they wait inside.

sec01-card-sec01-F41.question_text: Which core driving maneuvers does the road examiner grade, and what happens if you break a traffic law?
sec01-card-sec01-F41.teaching_text: Smooth parking cannot rescue a score if rolling a stop line or speeding racks up law penalties.

sec01-card-sec01-F42.question_text: What happens if you touch a cell phone during the Nevada drive test, and which electronic aids are banned?
sec01-card-sec01-F42.teaching_text: Examiners test your own feet and eyes, never automated self-parking cameras or cruise buttons.

sec03-card-sec03-F01.question_text: How does the Nevada handbook rate seat belts for crash survival, and is wearing one optional?
sec03-card-sec03-F01.teaching_text: Airbags are supplemental cushions designed to work alongside buckled belts rather than replace them.

sec03-card-sec03-F02.question_text: In the twenty-twenty crash data cited by the Nevada handbook, what percentage of highway fatalities were unbelted drivers?
sec03-card-sec03-F02.teaching_text: Skipping a two-second click accounts for nearly one in four fatal roadway outcomes statewide.

sec03-card-sec03-F03.question_text: How many unbelted vehicle occupants died in Nevada across the five-year span from twenty-sixteen to twenty-twenty?
sec03-card-sec03-F03.teaching_text: Ejection from an unbuckled seat turns otherwise survivable rollovers and side impacts into fatal tragedies.

sec03-card-sec03-F04.question_text: What seat-belt equipment must any passenger car from model year nineteen sixty-eight or newer carry?
sec03-card-sec03-F04.teaching_text: Vintage car owners cannot claim antique exemptions once a vehicle hits this federal equipment milestone.

sec03-card-sec03-F05.question_text: Which seat belts and harnesses are required in cars from model year nineteen seventy or newer?
sec03-card-sec03-F05.teaching_text: Adding upper-torso harnesses in front keeps occupants from slamming chests and faces into steering wheels.

sec03-card-sec03-R03.question_text: How did mandatory seat-belt equipment expand from model year nineteen sixty-eight to nineteen seventy?
sec03-card-sec03-R03.teaching_text: Exam questions pair both vintage cutoffs to test who gained lap belts and shoulder harnesses.

sec03-card-sec03-F06.question_text: Beginning at what passenger age must everyone wear a safety belt whenever the seat has one?
sec03-card-sec03-F06.teaching_text: Back-seat passengers left unbuckled become heavy human projectiles during a frontal collision.

sec03-card-sec03-F07.question_text: What age threshold and height threshold require a child to ride in an approved child restraint system in Nevada?
sec03-card-sec03-F07.teaching_text: Adult belts ride dangerously across a small child's soft abdomen and neck until height catches up.

sec03-card-sec03-F08.question_text: What penalties can a driver face for failing to secure a young or short child in an approved restraint?
sec03-card-sec03-F08.teaching_text: Nevada treats unrestrained young children far more seriously than an ordinary parking or equipment ticket.

sec03-card-sec03-R04.question_text: How can breaking Nevada's child-restraint law directly threaten the driver's own license?
sec03-card-sec03-R04.teaching_text: Drivers assume child-seat citations bring small fines only, missing the statutory suspension power.

sec03-card-sec03-F09.question_text: Where and facing which direction must a child under age two ride in Nevada?
sec03-card-sec03-F09.teaching_text: Toddlers have heavy heads and fragile neck vertebrae that forward-facing harnesses cannot cradle safely.

sec03-card-sec03-F10.question_text: Which two dangerous belt or lap shortcuts must you never use with a child passenger?
sec03-card-sec03-F10.teaching_text: Crash deceleration multiplies body weight so violently that adult arms crush a lap-held child against the dash.

sec03-card-sec03-R01.question_text: What transitions happen at age two, age six, and fifty-seven inches under Nevada restraint law?
sec03-card-sec03-R01.teaching_text: Turning six alone does not graduate a child into adult belts if they remain shorter than the height bar.

sec03-card-sec03-F11.question_text: When is it illegal to leave a child aged seven or younger inside a vehicle, and what supervisor age changes that?
sec03-card-sec03-F11.teaching_text: Desert cabin temperatures spike to lethal heatstroke conditions within minutes even with windows cracked.

sec03-card-sec03-F12.question_text: What does Nevada law state about leaving dogs or cats in extreme temperatures, and what can responders do?
sec03-card-sec03-F12.teaching_text: Law enforcement and firefighters carry statutory authority to force entry and save trapped animals.

sec03-card-sec03-F13.question_text: What criminal classification applies to violating Nevada's unattended-child or unattended-pet vehicle laws?
sec03-card-sec03-F13.teaching_text: Quick-errand excuses will not spare a driver from a criminal misdemeanor record when kids or pets are endangered.

sec03-card-sec03-R02.question_text: Which two specific age cutoffs define Nevada's unattended-child-in-vehicle rule?
sec03-card-sec03-R02.teaching_text: Leaving an eight-year-old sibling in charge of a toddler still violates the minimum supervisor age.

sec03-card-sec03-R05.question_text: How does the legal trigger for leaving a young child unattended differ from the trigger for a dog or cat?
sec03-card-sec03-R05.teaching_text: Child endangerment covers running engines, power windows, or abduction risks alongside desert heat or cold.

sec03-card-sec03-F14.question_text: What physical job do booster seats and belt-positioning seats perform for growing children?
sec03-card-sec03-F14.teaching_text: Elevating hips and shoulders routes crash force onto strong pelvic and collarbone structure instead of soft organs.

sec03-card-sec03-F15.question_text: What federal approval and fit checks should you verify on a child seat before driving?
sec03-card-sec03-F15.teaching_text: Hand-me-down or outgrown carriers fail in crashes if straps sit below or above rated body limits.

sec03-card-sec03-F16.question_text: Whose instructions or approved methods must you follow when installing a child restraint?
sec03-card-sec03-F16.teaching_text: Loose anchors or twisted belt paths let an expensive car seat launch forward on impact.

sec03-card-sec03-F17.question_text: Which direction must infants always face in a car, and what parts of the body does that protect?
sec03-card-sec03-F17.teaching_text: Rear-facing shells spread frontal crash energy evenly across the entire back rather than snapping the neck forward.

sec03-card-sec03-R07.question_text: How does a booster seat secure a child differently than a rear-facing infant seat?
sec03-card-sec03-R07.teaching_text: Switching to a belt-positioning booster too early removes the five-point harness and head-cradling shell.

sec03-card-sec03-R08.question_text: What three essential checks guarantee safe child-restraint travel on every trip?
sec03-card-sec03-R08.teaching_text: Missing even one link among federal approval, child sizing, or tight installation undermines crash survival.

sec03-card-sec03-F18.question_text: Where is the safest place for children to ride, and how should the seat be set if an older child must ride up front?
sec03-card-sec03-F18.teaching_text: Sliding the front track fully rearward adds critical breathing room away from explosive dashboard airbag deployment.

sec03-card-sec03-F19.question_text: What restraint setup keeps a child's head back out of an inflating airbag's path?
sec03-card-sec03-F19.teaching_text: Tucking a shoulder strap behind a child's back lets their upper body pitch straight into the deploying bag.

sec03-card-sec03-F20.question_text: Which passengers can suffer severe airbag injuries even during a minor fender-bender or sudden stop?
sec03-card-sec03-F20.teaching_text: Braking pitches unrestrained riders right onto the steering hub or dash milliseconds before the bag fires.

sec03-card-sec03-F21.question_text: Why must a rear-facing infant never be placed in front of an active passenger-side airbag?
sec03-card-sec03-F21.teaching_text: A rear-facing carrier puts the back of an infant's skull inches from the explosive dashboard cover.

sec03-card-sec03-R06.question_text: Contrast front-seat airbag rules for an older child when necessary versus an infant?
sec03-card-sec03-R06.teaching_text: No seat-track adjustment can ever make an active front airbag safe behind a rear-facing baby shell.

sec04-card-sec04-F02.question_text: How often should you inspect tire wear, and how does the penny test confirm safe tread depth?
sec04-card-sec04-F02.teaching_text: Bald grooves cannot channel rainwater away, turning summer storms into sudden hydroplaning spins.

sec04-card-sec04-R01.question_text: What five checks and adjustments should you complete inside the cabin before starting the engine?
sec04-card-sec04-R01.teaching_text: Fiddling with mirrors or seat tracks after rolling into traffic pulls your eyes off crosswalks.

sec04-card-sec04-R02.question_text: Once the engine is running, what should you check and do before pulling into motion?
sec04-card-sec04-R02.teaching_text: Keeping cabin volume modest and scanning for cyclists catches curbside movement before your wheels roll.

sec04-card-sec04-F03.question_text: What three core functions do highway signs serve, and why are their shapes and colors standardized?
sec04-card-sec04-F03.teaching_text: Standardized silhouettes let drivers recognize a stop or yield command through snow, glare, or distance.

sec04-card-sec04-F04.question_text: What traffic messages belong to red, green, yellow or yellow-green, and white sign backgrounds?
sec04-card-sec04-F04.teaching_text: Reading background color instantly separates mandatory white speed laws from yellow curve advisories.
sec04-card-sec04-F04.must_match_memory_hook: Red stops, green guides, yellow warns

visual_sync.text_span: Red stops, green guides, yellow warns

sec04-card-sec04-F05.question_text: What do orange, blue, and brown highway sign colors each indicate?
sec04-card-sec04-F05.teaching_text: Spotting orange diamonds ahead cues immediate speed drops long before lanes narrow around road crews.
sec04-card-sec04-F05.must_match_memory_hook: Orange work, blue services, brown parks

visual_sync.text_span: Orange work, blue services, brown parks

sec04-card-sec04-F06.question_text: What messages are carried by octagon, diamond, rectangle, and inverted-triangle sign shapes?
sec04-card-sec04-F06.teaching_text: Even from the back side across an intersection, an upside-down triangle or eight-sided silhouette reveals cross-traffic rules.
sec04-card-sec04-F06.must_match_memory_hook: Octagon stops, triangle yields, diamond warns

visual_sync.text_span: Octagon stops, triangle yields, diamond warns

sec04-card-sec04-F07.question_text: What do pennant, pentagon, circle, crossbuck, and shield shapes each mean on the road?
sec04-card-sec04-F07.teaching_text: Permit exams love testing pennant versus pentagon because learners constantly swap those two five-letter-feeling shapes.
sec04-card-sec04-F07.must_match_memory_hook: Pennant pass-ban, pentagon school, round rail

visual_sync.text_span: Pennant pass-ban, pentagon school, round rail

sec04-card-sec04-R03.question_text: How does a round railroad sign differ in placement and meaning from an X-shaped crossbuck?
sec04-card-sec04-R03.teaching_text: Slowing at the yellow circle prepares your stop well before reaching the white crossbuck beside the rails.

sec04-card-sec04-R04.question_text: Which sign shape marks school zones and crossings, and which marks no-passing zones?
sec04-card-sec04-R04.teaching_text: Picture a five-sided schoolhouse roof for pentagons and a sideways triangle flag on the left for no passing.

sec04-card-sec04-R06.question_text: What shape are route markers typically, and which three highway systems do they identify?
sec04-card-sec04-R06.teaching_text: Recognizing route shields quickly helps you confirm freeway exits without staring off the road.

sec04-card-sec04-F15.question_text: What shape are most work-zone signs, how must you drive through them, and how are tickets penalized?
sec04-card-sec04-F15.teaching_text: Workers stand feet from moving mirrors with zero steel protection, so Nevada raises fines inside work zones.
sec04-card-sec04-F15.must_match_memory_hook: Orange diamonds, obey flaggers, higher fines

visual_sync.text_span: Orange diamonds, obey flaggers, higher fines

sec04-card-sec04-R10.question_text: What job do cones, drums, and barricades perform in construction zones day and night?
sec04-card-sec04-R10.teaching_text: Following channelizing lines smoothly keeps your tires out of open trenches and closed shoulder drops.

sec04-card-sec04-F08.question_text: Where must your wheels stop first at a stop sign, and how do you handle a blind cross street?
sec04-card-sec04-F08.teaching_text: Rolling past the painted crosswalk first puts your bumper right where pedestrians walk.

sec04-card-sec04-F09.question_text: Where do you stop and whom do you yield to when a stop sign has no painted line or crosswalk?
sec04-card-sec04-F09.teaching_text: Stopping at the sightline edge before entering cross-traffic lanes protects walkers and through cars alike.

sec04-card-sec04-F10.question_text: Which vehicles take priority ahead of you when pulling up to a four-way stop?
sec04-card-sec04-F10.teaching_text: Jumping your turn out of arrival order causes mid-box T-bone collisions from hesitant cross traffic.

sec04-card-sec04-F11.question_text: How does a yield sign operate compared with a stop sign, and which four road users take priority?
sec04-card-sec04-F11.teaching_text: Notice Nevada explicitly includes vehicles making U-turns alongside walkers and highway traffic in its yield rule.

sec04-card-sec04-R05.question_text: What single requirement separates every stop sign from a yield sign when the intersection looks empty?
sec04-card-sec04-R05.teaching_text: Treating an octagonal stop sign like a rolling yield is an automatic drive-test failure.

sec04-card-sec04-F12.question_text: What must you do when an emergency vehicle approaches running red lights and siren, and where must you never stop?
sec04-card-sec04-F12.teaching_text: Freezing mid-intersection blocks the exact turning radius a fire ladder or ambulance needs to get through.

sec04-card-sec04-F16.question_text: How must you handle an intersection when all overhead traffic signals lose power and go dark?
sec04-card-sec04-F16.teaching_text: Blowing straight through dead signal heads during a power outage causes catastrophic full-speed broadsides.

sec04-card-sec04-F17.question_text: Where must you stop at a steady red light when not turning, and when may you move forward?
sec04-card-sec04-F17.teaching_text: Creeping across crosswalk stripes on red crowds pedestrians and risks nose-clipping turning cross-traffic.

sec04-card-sec04-F18.question_text: Under what conditions may you turn right against a steady red traffic light in Nevada?
sec04-card-sec04-F18.teaching_text: Rolling a right-on-red without halting first misses pedestrians stepping off the right-hand curb.

sec04-card-sec04-F19.question_text: How should you respond to a steady yellow light before versus after entering the intersection?
sec04-card-sec04-F19.teaching_text: Flooring the gas on stale yellow puts you mid-box right as cross-traffic launches on green.
sec04-card-sec04-F19.must_match_memory_hook: Stop outside, clear inside, never race

visual_sync.text_span: Stop outside, clear inside, never race

sec04-card-sec04-F20.question_text: Which directions may you travel on a standard green light, and what limits that?
sec04-card-sec04-F20.teaching_text: Always scan beside green bulbs for regulatory signs banning left turns during rush hours.

sec04-card-sec04-F21.question_text: Contrast the required driver action at a flashing red light versus a flashing yellow light?
sec04-card-sec04-F21.teaching_text: Stopping dead beneath a flashing yellow invites rear-end hits, whereas rolling flashing red causes T-bones.

sec04-card-sec04-F22.question_text: What does a lit red arrow prohibit, and may you turn in that direction after stopping?
sec04-card-sec04-F22.teaching_text: Unlike a circular red ball on right turns, a red arrow blocks that turn until the arrow changes.

sec04-card-sec04-F23.question_text: How does a steady yellow arrow differ in meaning from a flashing yellow arrow?
sec04-card-sec04-F23.teaching_text: Flashing yellow arrows permit turns through oncoming gaps, whereas steady yellow warns red is moments away.

sec04-card-sec04-F24.question_text: What protection does a green arrow provide, and whom must you still yield to anyway?
sec04-card-sec04-F24.teaching_text: Late pedestrians or cyclists finishing a crossing still hold priority even when oncoming cars have red.

sec04-card-sec04-F25.question_text: Under what exact street layout and steps is a left turn on a red light legal in Nevada?
sec04-card-sec04-F25.teaching_text: Turning left on red from or onto a two-way street drives straight across live opposing lanes.

sec04-card-sec04-R07.question_text: Distinguish a steady yellow ball, a flashing yellow ball, and a flashing yellow arrow?
sec04-card-sec04-R07.teaching_text: Sorting all three amber signals prevents panic stops on flashing caution and unsafe turns across oncoming cars.

sec04-card-sec04-R08.question_text: Why is turning right on red common while turning left on red applies in only one street setup?
sec04-card-sec04-R08.teaching_text: Right turns merge curb-to-curb without crossing opposing lanes, whereas left-on-red works safely only between one-ways.

sec04-card-sec04-R09.question_text: What required action do a flashing red signal and a dark powerless traffic light share?
sec04-card-sec04-R09.teaching_text: Whenever normal green-yellow-red cycling is absent or blinking red, every approach defaults to stop-first discipline.

sec04-card-sec04-F26.question_text: When no separate pedestrian signal is present, how must walkers obey red, yellow, and green traffic lights?
sec04-card-sec04-F26.teaching_text: Stepping off the curb on yellow leaves walkers stranded mid-street when cross traffic gets green.

sec04-card-sec04-F27.question_text: What does an illuminated WALK word or walking-person symbol require from nearby drivers?
sec04-card-sec04-F27.teaching_text: Drivers watching left or right turn gaps must still stop for walkers sharing the same green phase.

sec04-card-sec04-F28.question_text: In Nevada, how does a flashing upraised hand with a countdown timer differ from a flashing hand without numbers?
sec04-card-sec04-F28.teaching_text: Nevada's countdown rule specifically allows starting if you finish before zero, unlike unnumbered flashing hands.

sec04-card-sec04-F29.question_text: What must pedestrians on the curb versus already in the street do when a steady DON'T WALK hand shows?
sec04-card-sec04-F29.teaching_text: Cross-street traffic is about to get green, leaving zero time for fresh step-offs.

sec04-card-sec04-R11.question_text: May a pedestrian step out on a green turn arrow alone, and what rule governs marked crosswalks?
sec04-card-sec04-R11.teaching_text: Green turn arrows release fast-turning vehicles straight across the parallel crosswalk without expecting walkers.

sec04-card-sec04-R12.question_text: Where do most pedestrian fatalities occur, and who holds safety responsibility?
sec04-card-sec04-R12.teaching_text: Higher mid-block vehicle speeds and parked-car sight blocks turn jaywalking encounters fatal fast.

sec04-card-sec04-F41.question_text: What offense grade applies to disobeying a Nevada school crossing guard, and when may you drive across?
sec04-card-sec04-F41.teaching_text: Rolling past as soon as children reach the curb while the guard remains in the paint breaks state law.

sec04-card-sec04-F42.question_text: What are Nevada's two school-zone speed limits, when do timed zones run, and what if yellow beacons are off during class?
sec04-card-sec04-F42.teaching_text: Arrival and dismissal surges create maximum child foot traffic thirty minutes outside bell times.

sec04-card-sec04-F43.question_text: When are U-turns prohibited in a Nevada school zone, and when are they allowed?
sec04-card-sec04-F43.teaching_text: Swinging an unexpected three-point or U-turn amid school drop-off lines blindsides crossing kids.

sec04-card-sec04-R20.question_text: Which two posted speed limits govern Nevada school zones, and how do beacons clarify active times?
sec04-card-sec04-R20.teaching_text: Flashing yellow school beacons eliminate guesswork over bell schedules on unfamiliar neighborhood routes.

sec04-card-sec04-F30.question_text: What two colors are pavement lines, and what do broken white lines indicate?
sec04-card-sec04-F30.teaching_text: Straddling dashed lane stripes confuses overtaking drivers nearby and invites sudden sideswipe collisions.

sec04-card-sec04-F31.question_text: What does a solid white stripe mean between same-direction lanes, and what road borders does it mark?
sec04-card-sec04-F31.teaching_text: Solid white lines lock lanes near intersections and weave zones where sudden switches cause crashes.
sec04-card-sec04-F31.must_match_memory_hook: No lane changes, marks right edge

visual_sync.text_span: No lane changes, marks right edge

sec04-card-sec04-F32.question_text: What traffic split do yellow lines mark, and how do broken and solid yellow lines differ?
sec04-card-sec04-F32.teaching_text: Seeing yellow paint on your right means you are driving the wrong way into oncoming headlights.
sec04-card-sec04-F32.must_match_memory_hook: Opposite flow, broken passes, solid holds

visual_sync.text_span: Opposite flow, broken passes, solid holds

sec04-card-sec04-F33.question_text: Along a double yellow centerline with one broken and one solid stripe, when is passing forbidden?
sec04-card-sec04-F33.teaching_text: Road engineers paint the solid bar on the side with curves or hills hiding oncoming cars.
sec04-card-sec04-F33.must_match_memory_hook: Forbidden when solid hugs your side

visual_sync.text_span: Forbidden when solid hugs your side

sec04-card-sec04-F34.question_text: Where must you stop at painted crosswalks, and what applies at intersections without painted crosswalk lines?
sec04-card-sec04-F34.teaching_text: Sidewalk extensions across any corner form legal unmarked crosswalks even without white paint.

sec04-card-sec04-F35.question_text: How is a center left-turn lane painted, what maneuvers are allowed, and what uses are banned?
sec04-card-sec04-F35.teaching_text: Cruising down the shared middle lane to pass backed-up traffic sets up a head-on crash with opposing turners.

sec04-card-sec04-F36.question_text: Under Nevada law, what is the maximum distance you may travel inside a center turn lane before turning left versus after entering?
sec04-card-sec04-F36.teaching_text: Exam questions specifically test this asymmetric pair so drivers merge promptly instead of cruising down the middle.

sec04-card-sec04-R13.question_text: How does a broken white lane line contrast with a solid white line between same-direction lanes?
sec04-card-sec04-R13.teaching_text: Knowing solid white forbids crossing in Nevada prevents tickets that other states treat as mere warnings.

sec04-card-sec04-R14.question_text: What overarching rule separates white roadway markings from yellow centerline markings?
sec04-card-sec04-R14.teaching_text: One glance at lane paint tells you immediately on dark ramps whether adjacent lanes move with or against you.

sec04-card-sec04-R15.question_text: What do wide white stop lines and short dotted white lines each mark on the pavement?
sec04-card-sec04-R15.teaching_text: Short closely spaced white dots warn early that your freeway lane is peeling off onto an exit ramp.

sec04-card-sec04-F14.question_text: What actions do railroad crossing warning signs call for as you approach the tracks?
sec04-card-sec04-F14.teaching_text: Relying on quiet tracks without looking both ways misses fast locomotives at passive rural crossings.

sec04-card-sec04-F37.question_text: At least how far back from the nearest rail must you stop when a train approaches?
sec04-card-sec04-F37.teaching_text: Locomotives overhang wider than steel rails, clipping hoods crept too close to the ties.

sec04-card-sec04-F38.question_text: Which two vehicle categories must stop at railroad crossings even when signals stay dark and tracks look clear?
sec04-card-sec04-F38.teaching_text: Trailing behind a school bus or fuel tanker without expecting a track stop causes sudden rear-end crashes.

sec04-card-sec04-F39.question_text: What is the rule at a lowered railroad gate versus at flashing red crossing lights without a gate?
sec04-card-sec04-F39.teaching_text: Zigzagging around dropped arms frequently puts drivers straight into a second train hidden behind the first.

sec04-card-sec04-F40.question_text: Within what distance of the nearest railroad rail is parking strictly prohibited?
sec04-card-sec04-F40.teaching_text: Parked cars close to crossings block sightlines down the tracks for every approaching driver.

sec04-card-sec04-R16.question_text: Contrast Nevada's minimum stopping distance for an approaching train against its no-parking distance from rails?
sec04-card-sec04-R16.teaching_text: Test makers put fifteen and fifty side by side as answer choices to catch mixed-up rail numbers.

sec04-card-sec04-R17.question_text: What two precautions apply at multi-track railroad crossings?
sec04-card-sec04-R17.teaching_text: Waiting for a departed caboose to uncover the second track prevents rolling into an opposite-direction train, and steady gears prevent stalls.

sec04-card-sec04-R18.question_text: What three facts explain why motorists must always yield at a railroad crossbuck?
sec04-card-sec04-R18.teaching_text: Freight trains take up to a mile to halt while optical illusions make fast engines appear slow.

sec04-card-sec04-R19.question_text: What three steps must you take immediately if your vehicle stalls across railroad tracks?
sec04-card-sec04-R19.teaching_text: Calling the railroad's posted crossing number alerts dispatchers to halt trains miles away before 911 relays.

sec02-card-sec02-F01.question_text: Along with a parent or guardian co-signer, what document must an applicant under eighteen sign?
sec02-card-sec02-F01.teaching_text: Signing that acknowledgment removes any excuse later that a teen never heard about zero-tolerance license loss.

sec02-card-sec02-F02.question_text: What chemical test reading triggers a young-driver license revocation in Nevada, and how long does it last?
sec02-card-sec02-F02.teaching_text: Even a single drink easily crosses Nevada's strict youth threshold and strips driving privileges for half a year.

sec02-card-sec02-F03.question_text: How long is a young driver's license revoked if a court finds they drove impaired by alcohol or controlled substances?
sec02-card-sec02-F03.teaching_text: Whether proven by chemical number or courtroom evidence, impaired teen driving triggers the same lengthy revocation.

sec02-card-sec02-F04.question_text: Which graffiti, drug, or alcohol offenses can suspend or delay a young person's license for up to two years?
sec02-card-sec02-F04.teaching_text: Teens are often shocked that spray paint or party possession off the road can freeze permit eligibility.

sec02-card-sec02-F05.question_text: How long are driving privileges suspended or delayed for a first versus second youth firearm violation?
sec02-card-sec02-F05.teaching_text: Unlawful weapon handling hits your DMV record directly even when no vehicle was involved.

sec02-card-sec02-F06.question_text: What license suspension or permit delay penalties apply to first and repeat habitual truancy offenses?
sec02-card-sec02-F06.teaching_text: Nevada links classroom attendance directly to driving privileges so chronic unexcused absences sideline your permit.

sec02-card-sec02-F07.question_text: How long is your license suspended for joining or helping stage an unauthorized speed contest or trick-driving display?
sec02-card-sec02-F07.teaching_text: Even blocking an intersection or filming to facilitate sideshow stunts risks losing your license alongside racers.

sec02-card-sec02-F08.question_text: How do first-time DUI penalties for a young driver compare with penalties for drivers over twenty-one?
sec02-card-sec02-F08.teaching_text: Youth status grants zero leniency once impairment crosses into a full first-offense DUI prosecution.

sec02-card-sec02-R01.question_text: Contrast what happens to a young driver at a low alcohol reading versus a full first-time DUI?
sec02-card-sec02-R01.teaching_text: Test items check whether you separate Nevada's youth administrative threshold from full criminal adult sanctions.

sec02-card-sec02-F09.question_text: Which two completed records must a teen bring to the drive test, and what ink rule applies?
sec02-card-sec02-F09.teaching_text: Showing up with pencil entries or trying to fill hours in the waiting line delays your road exam.

sec02-card-sec02-F10.question_text: Which signed school form must every instruction-permit applicant under eighteen turn in at the DMV?
sec02-card-sec02-F10.teaching_text: Principals or designated school officials verify active enrollment before the state issues a learner permit.

sec02-card-sec02-F11.question_text: What does a minor who already finished high school submit with the attendance form, and how fresh must the signature be?
sec02-card-sec02-F11.teaching_text: An outdated school form older than two months gets bounced even with a valid diploma copy attached.

sec02-card-sec02-R02.question_text: What must a student suspended for habitual truancy bring to the DMV to reinstate driving privileges?
sec02-card-sec02-R02.teaching_text: Waiting out time alone is not enough without fresh school verification that classes are being attended.

sec02-card-sec02-F12.question_text: Through what two classroom formats can a Nevada teen complete driver's education?
sec02-card-sec02-F12.teaching_text: Taking an unapproved web course wastes tuition when its certificate fails DMV verification.

sec02-card-sec02-F13.question_text: Who qualifies to log extra behind-the-wheel hours instead of driver's education, and how many hours are required?
sec02-card-sec02-F13.teaching_text: Simply preferring parent practice over classes never waives coursework if online or nearby schools exist.

sec02-card-sec02-F14.question_text: How many total and nighttime supervised driving hours must teens living within thirty miles of an approved school log?
sec02-card-sec02-F14.teaching_text: Deliberate after-dark practice builds glare and depth judgment before solo evening driving begins.

sec02-card-sec02-R03.question_text: Compare total and nighttime logged hours on Nevada's standard teen path versus the remote rural path?
sec02-card-sec02-R03.teaching_text: Notice that total hours double on the rural exemption while the dark-driving requirement stays identical.

sec02-card-sec02-R04.question_text: How does the lighting rule change if those one hundred remote-path practice hours are for a motorcycle license?
sec02-card-sec02-R04.teaching_text: Because motorcycle learners are barred from riding after dark, every single logged hour stays in daytime.

sec02-card-sec02-F15.question_text: What three blemishes must stay completely off a minor's record for six months before licensing?
